style.name: Ragged Oracle
style.line: torn painted edges and charcoal seams
style.shading: layered opaque pigment with coarse fibre
style.silhouette: offset wrapped cowls and pennant-like split cloth
style.style_block: Painted mixed media with torn pigment edges, charcoal seams, coarse fibre impressions and patched colour masses fused into a spatially convincing world. Asymmetric wrapped cowls and diagonal cloth silhouettes. Dirty indigo, clay, soot, faded cream, warm brass and restrained elemental accents. Frayed textile, crooked driftwood, laced shields, cracked wrapped wardstones. Resourceful wild magic, quiet rubbed ground.

input.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE richly painted late-1990s computer role-playing bust portrait of Cassia, the adult Water battle mage. A single vertical ornate worn frame occupies the middle of a 16:9 dark painted field; no second portrait or panel. Bust from upper chest upward, face large and legible inside the frame. Three-quarter head turned slightly left, gaze toward viewer, forceful side light, deep shadow on the other cheek, quiet dark backdrop.
DIRECTION BLOCK:
Painted mixed media with torn pigment edges, charcoal seams, coarse fibre impressions and patched colour masses fused into a spatially convincing world. Asymmetric wrapped cowls and diagonal cloth silhouettes. Dirty indigo, clay, soot, faded cream, warm brass and restrained elemental accents. Frayed textile, crooked driftwood, laced shields, cracked wrapped wardstones. Resourceful wild magic, quiet rubbed ground.
FIXED CHARACTER: Cassia is an adult woman in her late thirties, olive skin, dark wavy hair with a few silver strands, strong long nose, asymmetrical brows, deep-set grey-blue eyes, broad cheekbones, weathered tired skin and a steady defiant expression. Characterful believable face, neither idealised doll nor glamorous fashion model. No facial injury. A loose worn deep-blue hood sits back from the face above pale blue and ivory layered cloth, practical crossed straps, tarnished bronze fasteners, a small cloudy-glass water talisman, and the edge of her equipped staff beside one shoulder. She is a field magician, not a civic official.
FIXED MOOD AND LIGHT: rich dark painterly bust, saturated blue-green reflected water light under the warm lit face, small suspended droplets, thin water vapour and subtle wave-shaped energy behind her shoulder. Brush marks build volume and lived character. Ornate frame has visible rubbed corners, tarnish, chips and invented tidal ornament; it feels old and handled. Strong portrait mood, deep colour, clear face, elemental aura. Frame and costume follow the direction; the face remains richly PAINTED in every direction. No flat mural face or parchment.
Original designs only. Hand-drawn digital 2D concept art with visible imperfect marks, wear and material history. Raw, forceful, fantastical magic. Roman-inspired arena culture is a distant worldbuilding base, not a museum illustration. No gore, wounds, corpses, dismemberment or injury depiction. No photographic or 3D rendering, polished generic fantasy finish, clean vector contours, readable text, labels, logo or watermark. No copied characters. Invented abstract rune glyphs are allowed. Use the SAME direction language for people, equipment, creatures and architecture. This is a complete artwork, not a character sheet or multipanel grid.
